description: Introduction and overview of the Chrysler 300 Letter Series (1955-1965): What this car is, its place in automotive history, and why collectors care. The Chrysler 300 'letter series' — C-300 through 300L — was the 'banker's hot rod': America's most powerful car for most of its run, with Hemi V8s up to 390 hp. The 1955 C-300's 300 hp gave the series its name. These were the original American muscle-luxury cars.
